description.value: Cockney Kings is a family-owned fish and chips institution that has been serving classic English-style fish and chips in Metro Vancouver since 1965, growing from a single East Hastings shop to four locations across the Lower Mainland. The New Westminster location is a full-service dine-in restaurant offering traditional battered fish — cod, haddock, snapper, salmon, and halibut — fried in beef tallow alongside hand-cut chips, seafood starters, and comfort sides. It remains a multi-generational family operation with a loyal local following built over six decades.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-documented, long-established family restaurant offering dine-in and takeout; a solid refuelling stop for touring cyclists in the New Westminster area.
enrichment_extras.notes: This OSM record represents the New Westminster location of a four-location chain. The other locations (Burnaby at 6574 Hastings Street, Kitsilano at 1935 Cornwall Avenue, and Main Street Vancouver at 4360 Main Street) may warrant separate OSM and directory entries.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ confirms gluten-friendly options (grilled or steamed fish, garden salad, coleslaw, Caesar salad without croutons, fish tacos on locally made corn tortillas); chips noted as technically gluten-free but sharing fryers with wheat products. Vegetarian-suitable salads and certain sides available, though deep-fried items including chips are cooked in beef tallow
